summary: ASTRA HEALTH is a web-based astronaut health monitoring and wellness dashboard designed to support crew health during space missions. It allows users to record and monitor key health indicators, including heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, sleep, mood, and symptoms. Through interactive charts, health trends, automated alerts, and personalized wellness insights, ASTRA HEALTH helps identify potential health concerns and supports informed health monitoring. Inspired by NASA's Human Research Program, the project explores how digital health technologies can contribute to astronaut safety and well-being during long-duration space missions.
details:
ASTRA HEALTH: Astronaut Health Monitoring and Wellness Dashboard

Project Overview

ASTRA HEALTH is a Flask-based web application developed to explore the challenges of monitoring astronaut health during space missions. In environments where access to conventional medical facilities is limited, continuous health tracking and early identification of potential concerns become especially important.

Key Features

  • Health Check-ins: Records heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, sleep duration, mood, and symptoms.
  • Health Analytics: Displays interactive charts and historical health readings to help identify trends.
  • Automated Alerts: Highlights potentially concerning entries and missed health check-ins.
  • Daily Wellness Intelligence: Provides wellness insights based on recorded health information.
  • Mission Health Timeline: Organizes health readings into a timeline for easier monitoring.
  • NASA Hazard Intelligence: Presents information about five space-related health hazards, with links to NASA Human Research Program resources.
  • Countermeasure Guidance: Provides informational guidance related to astronaut health and well-being.
  • Flight Health Reports: Generates printable health reports and allows health records to be downloaded as CSV files.
  • Crew Profiles: Supports individual accounts, crew profiles, and separate health records.

Technology Used

  • Python: Application logic and data processing.
  • Flask: Web application framework.
  • SQLite: Health-record storage.
  • HTML and CSS: Dashboard structure and visual design.
  • JavaScript and Chart.js: Interactive health visualizations.
  • Werkzeug: Password hashing and authentication.

Relevance to Space Exploration

Long-duration space missions expose astronauts to challenges such as microgravity, isolation, altered sleep cycles, and other environmental hazards. ASTRA HEALTH explores how an integrated digital monitoring system could help organize health information, identify changes over time, and support crew wellness.

Future Potential

Future development could include integration with wearable health-monitoring devices, real-time biometric data, predictive analytics, and more advanced health-risk assessment tools.
